new_in_release.expect: Q3 numbers not pre-released. A full Blackford quarter plus PBLJ at its reduced dayrate suggests revenue near Q2's USD 44.9m. No Q3 consensus can be found, so the direction is unknown.

Borgland Dolphin start date. The rig is still moored in Las Palmas on 26 Nov with no destination, so a December or later start offshore Spain is likely. That is a slip from 'November 2026'. Mildly negative.
Blackford impairment or loss on sale: USD 18m book value against USD 10m cash plus a contingent USD 15m. Expect a non-cash loss in Q3 or Q4, a small negative on the headline.
Q3 cash after the Borgland SPS capex, and liquidity bridging to Borgland revenue with Blackford gone and debt amortisation starting January 2027. Unknown, leans negative.
Q4 will be a trough quarter: Blackford off contract from 15 Oct and Borgland not yet earning. Known qualitatively, magnitude unknown.
Strategy under the new Executive Chairman (consolidation, rigs under management). Unknown, could be either way.

findings.finding: On 26 Nov 2026 two AIS services show the Borgland Dolphin moored in Las Palmas with no destination. The company guided it 'on contract from November 2026' for Repsol's P&A campaign offshore Spain, a tow of about two weeks, so the Q3 release will most likely report a start in December or later.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean prior on a Borgland timing change. Results days have mostly been sold: Q3 2025 -4.08%, Q1 2026 -5.33%, Q2 2026 -2.01%, Q4 2025 +0.79%. The stock fell 11.6% on 16 Nov 2026 while the Blackford closing ran late, which shows it punishes execution slippage.
findings.source_date: 2026-11-26 (page: 'Navigation Status Moored, Position Received 2 min ago', 'Destination not available')
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing on NewsWeb since the 16 Sep deck revises the November start (NewsWeb list for DDRIL through 26 Nov), and neither the Norwegian press nor the trade press reports a mobilisation or a delay. If the market held a slip, there would be no 10% 5-day rebound into the print. With two analysts and no short register anchor, nobody tracks the rig's AIS.
findings.independence: Maritime Optima also places it in Las Palmas, moored, last port call Las Palmas with no departure (https://maritimeoptima.com/public/vessels/pages/imo:8758469/mmsi:310802000/BORGLAND_DOLPHIN.html). The guide it is measured against is the company's Pareto deck of 2026-09-16 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=682425). Caveat: 'on contract' could count from departure, and the slip may be only weeks, inside the 'by November' tolerance. That is why the size is small.

findings.finding: The Blackford Dolphin was sold for USD 10m cash plus USD 15m contingent against a USD 18m book value at 30 June 2026, so the Q3 or Q4 accounts should show a non-cash impairment or loss of roughly USD 3-8m (the market cap is about USD 75m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 impairments sat inside the -4.08% Q3 2025 day and the +0.79% Q4 2025 day. The sale itself was bought: +12.5% on 27 Oct and +15% on 29 Oct 2026.
findings.source_date: 2026-08-19 (Q2 audiocast attachment: 'Book values for Paul B. Loyd Jr at USD 36.8m, Borgland USD 31.5m and Blackford USD 18m')
findings.why_not_priced: Both numbers are public, so this is computable and mostly priced. What is new is only the headline loss and its quarter. Non-cash, with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.
